lines.text: When you check your suitcase at an airport ticket counter, how does it navigate miles of tunnels to your plane?
It rides a subterranean roller coaster network stretching dozens of miles beneath the airport terminal.
When check-in tags your bag, a ten-digit barcode containing flight, passenger, and destination data is encoded.
High-speed optical laser tunnels scan the barcode from all six angles as the bag zooms by at thirty miles an hour.
Automated pusher arms kick the suitcase onto specific conveyor spurs heading toward automated explosive scanners.
Robotic destination loaders drop the bag into the exact cart heading for your aircraft cargo hold.
Over ninety-nine percent of airport baggage arrives smoothly at its final destination.
